name: Parchment Ledger
description: A warm editorial design system for read-only crypto portfolio aggregation, themed on the Claude (Anthropic) design language: parchment surfaces, exclusively warm neutrals, one terracotta accent, serif display type, and tabular mono figures. Built for Crypto Pocket Butler.

source.origin: Crypto Pocket Butler product requirements (BRD-001 to BRD-012), 2026-11-02
